_comment: AI-ASSISTED SCAFFOLD from CLARENCE_ZHEN_JIN_TAN_SPECIALISED_WORK_PACKAGE.md §12.1 (C-16 executable assurance case). NOT authorship evidence. An orphan use/harm/control/test/reviewer/authority blocks the affected maturity state. Executable tests are green here; reviewer and authority gates are human and remain PENDING — an authorised person, not Clarence, records the maturity decision (WP §12.9).

claims.statement: Public and staff surfaces never disagree on the retained decision, and restricted staff values cannot change public output.
claims.permitted_wording: evidence-symmetric but authority-asymmetric applications with value-level non-interference
claims.affected_party: public users and London Sport staff
claims.harm: leaked staff information, or public/staff disagreement that misleads a decision

claims.statement: Missing or unknown evidence is never rendered as a negative fact.
claims.permitted_wording: unknown is rendered as 'not published', never as 'no' or 'free'
claims.harm: user misled into believing an activity is unavailable/free when the data is simply silent
claims.residual_risk: wording to be corrected in Clarence's own words + reviewed

claims.statement: No unsupported factual token reaches a user.
claims.permitted_wording: verify-before-render; only verified claims are rendered
claims.harm: a fluent but unsupported statement is believed

claims.statement: The interface preserves the certified slate and order; client controls cannot bypass abstention.
claims.permitted_wording: map/list/sort preserve the certified slate and order
claims.harm: a re-ordered or padded list presents a non-certified result as certified

controls.desc: immutable certified order; IA coverage of every state

claims.statement: Restricted staff information cannot leak to the public plane; staff access is role-gated.
claims.harm: receipts/lineage/aggregates or research identity exposed publicly

controls.desc: disclosure classes + server-side role gate + per-role capabilities

claims.residual_risk: real IAM/break-glass is Wesley's; role gate here is a stub

claims.statement: Forged, stale, swapped or illegally escalated evidence is rejected by an independent checker.
claims.harm: a wrong production decision is trusted

controls.desc: independent checker; §10.5 negative tests; branch mutation testing

claims.residual_risk: production/reference/checker discrepancy register empty until production emits certificates

claims.statement: Application effects are not confounded with retrieval, ranking or content differences.
claims.harm: an interface effect is falsely attributed, invalidating a headline result

controls.desc: condition manifests with shared terminal DecisionEnvelope per task

claims.statement: Governed actions cannot skip independent review or approval, and sending requires an authorised role.
claims.harm: an unreviewed or unauthorised action is sent to a publisher

controls.desc: action-card state-machine gates + per-role capability matrix

claims.residual_risk: person-level independence (reviewer != author) needs real IAM

claims.statement: All pre-code reconciliation blockers are dispositioned with owner, tests and fallback.
claims.harm: a release-blocking ambiguity is hidden beneath an implementation choice

controls.desc: C-01 reconciliation register with completeness validation

claims.residual_risk: institutional cells remain PENDING until ratified

claims.statement: The applications are evaluated toward WCAG 2.2 AA within a stated, tested matrix (not a blanket conformance claim).
claims.permitted_wording: evaluated toward WCAG 2.2 AA within the tested matrix
claims.harm: an accessibility barrier prevents a tested route for material users

controls.desc: accessible components + static a11y subset + declared test matrix

claims.residual_risk: manual keyboard/screen-reader/AT/contrast testing OUTSTANDING; automated subset is one input only
